_meta.purpose: Calibrate RETRIEVAL_MIN_SCORE and act as a retrieval regression test.

sources.synthetic: Authored from published article titles, paraphrased into user language. Biased toward article vocabulary; overstates retrieval quality.
sources.incident: Verbatim short_description text from real incidents on this instance, matched by hand to the article that genuinely answers them. Spelling, casing and truncation are left exactly as users wrote them.

_meta.findingThatMatters: The incident corpus is mostly NOT knowledge-base-answerable. Of 36,023 incidents, the dominant traffic is machine-generated monitoring alerts ('Critical alert [Alert2276070] . Created on Node: []...'), reported-phishing emails, and fragments such as 'Hi Team,', 'nan' and '711 Tech Support Phone# - 2106249028'. Only a minority of real tickets map to an article. Expect a KB chatbot on this instance to answer 'no knowledge base match' for most genuine traffic — that is correct behaviour, not a defect, and the demo narrative should say so up front.
_meta.confidenceLevels: high = the article directly answers the ticket. medium = the article is the best available match and should rank first, but does not fully resolve the ticket. Medium cases test graceful degradation, not precision.
_meta.citationKey: sysId. Article numbers are NOT unique on this instance (KB0010004 maps to four different articles; KB0010141 to two), so sys_id is the only safe identifier.
_meta.noGroundTruthAvailable: m2m_kb_task is empty and kb_use carries no task reference, so the instance provides no article-to-incident pairs. All mappings below are hand-made.
_meta.scoring: A question passes if ANY sys_id in acceptableSysIds is returned. expectedSysId remains the primary/preferred answer and is always the first entry. Duplicates exist in this knowledge base (KB0010237 and KB0010239 are the same Outlook article; KBSGC0000019 and KBSGC0000021 the same Dynatrace article), so a single-sys_id expectation marks correct answers wrong.

baseline.measured: 2026-09-13, live against ServiceNow 123TEXTQUERY321 text search, limit 5
baseline.remainingMisses: inc-07, inc-11, inc-12, inc-13, syn-07, syn-14. Three are medium-confidence stretches. inc-07 and syn-14 are genuine recall failures: search returns 'What is the Windows key?' for both, matching on 'windows' and 'starts/monday'.
baseline.note: A regression is any run that scores below these figures.
